dialogues.speaker: Count Crushmore's Companion God of Cookery
dialogues.text: #Hey there, {NICKNAME}! How would you like to play another game with Guoba? He'd still like to test Bloom Pruner's skills!

choices.text: In that case, I shall be your Itto!

response.speaker: Count Crushmore's Companion God of Cookery
response.text: Nice! Time for another beetle battle!

choices.text: How are your preparations for reopening Wanmin Restaurant?

response.speaker: Count Crushmore's Companion God of Cookery
response.text: Oh, things back at the restaurant aren't too busy, which is why Guoba and I are free to play a few games. Thanks for the concern, though!

response.speaker: Count Crushmore's Companion God of Cookery
response.text: We've almost completed restocking, so we should be back to business as usual in a few more days!

response.speaker: Count Crushmore's Companion God of Cookery
response.text: If you and Paimon still haven't had enough, you're free to swing by for a meal any time!

choices.text: I've gotta go for now. Till next time!

response.speaker: Count Crushmore's Companion God of Cookery
